command $cg_wait() : int {

	input.clear

	while(1) {

		if (mouse.wheel > 0){
			break
		}
	
		if (input.decide.on_down_up == 1) {
		
			break
		
		}
		
		if (input.cancel.on_down_up == 1) {	
		
			return(1)
		
		}
	
		if (key[17].is_down == 1) {	
		
			timewait(150)
		
			key.clear
		
			break
		
		}
		
		





		
		
	
		input.next
		disp
	
	}
	
}
